paragraphs.text: But the Spirit saith expressly, that in later times some shall fall away from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
paragraphs.original: Τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα ῥητῶς λέγει ὅτι ἐν ὑστέροις καιροῖς ἀποστήσονταί τινες τῆς πίστεως, προσέχοντες πνεύμασι πλάνοις καὶ διδασκαλίαις δαιμονίων
paragraphs.translit: To de pneuma rhētōs legei hoti en hysterois kairois apostēsontai tines tēs pisteōs, prosechontes pneumasi planois kai didaskaliais daimoniōn

paragraphs.text: through the hypocrisy of men that speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron;
paragraphs.original: ἐν ὑποκρίσει ψευδολόγων, κεκαυστηριασμένων τὴν ἰδίαν συνείδησιν,
paragraphs.translit: en hypokrisei pseudologōn, kekaustēriasmenōn tēn idian syneidēsin,

paragraphs.text: forbidding to marry, [and commanding] to abstain from meats, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by them that believe and know the truth.
paragraphs.original: κωλυόντων γαμεῖν, ἀπέχεσθαι βρωμάτων ἃ ὁ θεὸς ἔκτισεν εἰς μετάλημψιν μετὰ εὐχαριστίας τοῖς πιστοῖς καὶ ἐπεγνωκόσι τὴν ἀλήθειαν.
paragraphs.translit: kōlyontōn gamein, apechesthai brōmatōn ha ho theos ektisen eis metalēmpsin meta eucharistias tois pistois kai epegnōkosi tēn alētheian.

paragraphs.text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it be received with thanksgiving:
paragraphs.original: ὅτι πᾶν κτίσμα θεοῦ καλόν, καὶ οὐδὲν ἀπόβλητον μετὰ εὐχαριστίας λαμβανόμενον,
paragraphs.translit: hoti pan ktisma theou kalon, kai ouden apoblēton meta eucharistias lambanomenon,

paragraphs.text: for it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
paragraphs.original: ἁγιάζεται γὰρ διὰ λόγου θεοῦ καὶ ἐντεύξεως.
paragraphs.translit: hagiazetai gar dia logou theou kai enteuxeōs.

paragraphs.text: If thou put the brethren in mind of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith, and of the good doctrine which thou hast followed [until now]:
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα ὑποτιθέμενος τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καλὸς ἔσῃ διάκονος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, ἐντρεφόμενος τοῖς λόγοις τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς καλῆς διδασκαλίας ᾗ παρηκολούθηκας,
paragraphs.translit: Tauta hypotithemenos tois adelphois kalos esē diakonos Christou Iēsou, entrephomenos tois logois tēs pisteōs kai tēs kalēs didaskalias hē parēkolouthēkas,

paragraphs.text: but refuse profane and old wives` fables. And exercise thyself unto godliness:
paragraphs.original: τοὺς δὲ βεβήλους καὶ γραώδεις μύθους παραιτοῦ. γύμναζε δὲ σεαυτὸν πρὸς εὐσέβειαν·
paragraphs.translit: tous de bebēlous kai graōdeis mythous paraitou. gymnaze de seauton pros eusebeian·

paragraphs.text: for bodily exercise is profitable for a little; but godliness is profitable for all things, having promise of the life which now is, and of that which is to come.
paragraphs.original: ἡ γὰρ σωματικὴ γυμνασία πρὸς ὀλίγον ἐστὶν ὠφέλιμος, ἡ δὲ εὐσέβεια πρὸς πάντα ὠφέλιμός ἐστιν, ἐπαγγελίαν ἔχουσα ζωῆς τῆς νῦν καὶ τῆς μελλούσης.
paragraphs.translit: hē gar sōmatikē gymnasia pros oligon estin ōphelimos, hē de eusebeia pros panta ōphelimos estin, epangelian echousa zōēs tēs nyn kai tēs mellousēs.

paragraphs.text: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation.
paragraphs.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος,
paragraphs.translit: pistos ho logos kai pasēs apodochēs axios,

paragraphs.text: For to this end we labor and strive, because we have our hope set on the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of them that believe.
paragraphs.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ κοπιῶμεν καὶ ὀνειδιζόμεθα, ὅτι ἠλπίκαμεν ἐπὶ θεῷ ζῶντι, ὅς ἐστιν σωτὴρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων, μάλιστα πιστῶν.
paragraphs.translit: eis touto gar kopiōmen kai oneidizometha, hoti ēlpikamen epi theō zōnti, hos estin sōtēr pantōn anthrōpōn, malista pistōn.

paragraphs.text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an ensample to them that believe, in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity.
paragraphs.original: μηδείς σου τῆς νεότητος καταφρονείτω, ἀλλὰ τύπος γίνου τῶν πιστῶν ἐν λόγῳ, ἐν ἀναστροφῇ, ἐν ἀγάπῃ, ἐν πίστει, ἐν ἁγνείᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: mēdeis sou tēs neotētos kataphroneitō, alla typos ginou tōn pistōn en logō, en anastrophē, en agapē, en pistei, en hagneia.

paragraphs.text: Till I come, give heed to reading, to exhortation, to teaching.
paragraphs.original: ἕως ἔρχομαι πρόσεχε τῇ ἀναγνώσει, τῇ παρακλήσει, τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ.
paragraphs.translit: heōs erchomai proseche tē anagnōsei, tē paraklēsei, tē didaskalia.

paragraphs.text: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
paragraphs.original: μὴ ἀμέλει τοῦ ἐν σοὶ χαρίσματος, ὃ ἐδόθη σοι διὰ προφητείας μετὰ ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν τοῦ πρεσβυτερίου.
paragraphs.translit: mē amelei tou en soi charismatos, ho edothē soi dia prophēteias meta epitheseōs tōn cheirōn tou presbyteriou.

paragraphs.text: Be diligent in these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy progress may be manifest unto all.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα μελέτα, ἐν τούτοις ἴσθι, ἵνα σου ἡ προκοπὴ φανερὰ ᾖ πᾶσιν·
paragraphs.translit: tauta meleta, en toutois isthi, hina sou hē prokopē phanera ē pasin·

paragraphs.text: Take heed to thyself, and to thy teaching. Continue in these things; for in doing this thou shalt save both thyself and them that hear thee.
paragraphs.original: ἔπεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ· ἐπίμενε αὐτοῖς· τοῦτο γὰρ ποιῶν καὶ σεαυτὸν σώσεις καὶ τοὺς ἀκούοντάς σου.
paragraphs.translit: epeche seautō kai tē didaskalia· epimene autois· touto gar poiōn kai seauton sōseis kai tous akouontas sou.
